papers.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
papers.abstract: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows, dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Muir, which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection, re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate, and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. Because standard chunkwise algorithms become numerically unstable at the large chunk sizes needed to saturate wide matrix units, we design a parallel update for stable, efficient training. Across 166M-1.34B parameters, Muir lowers perplexity by 1.8-2.0% over GDN-2 and 2.5-3.6% over Transformer, raises commonsense accuracy by up to 1.9 points, and improves extractive recall over GDN-2. At 1.34B, Muir outperforms both baselines on multi-hop and multi-needle recall, extrapolates 2,560x from its 4K training length to 10M-token streams without perplexity drift, and maintains near-100% passkey retrieval to 1M tokens with static readout. Muir achieves these gains while matching GDN-2 throughput, reaching its 100B-token validation loss 1.2x faster, and training 2.7x faster than Transformer at 32K.

digest.summaryZh: Muir按门控敏感性分配低秩参数，并以匹配滤波读出抑制慢衰减状态的主导效应，将节省参数投入FFN。稳定分块训练内核面向宽矩阵单元组织计算，适合研究线性注意力的矩阵与向量分工。
digest.motivationZh: 门控delta线性注意力的擦除与写入敏感性不同，状态行能量失衡还会干扰读出。为擦除与写入都配置全秩投影浪费预算，直接扩大chunk又会引发数值不稳定。门控参数、状态更新与计算布局共同影响长序列质量及硬件利用率。与混合注意力、矩阵向量协同和训练内核密切相关，建议精读稳定分块公式及算子归属。
digest.methodZh: 融合低秩门控投影，给擦除更低秩并对查询读出加增益，结合边界枢轴分块更新。敏感性分配门控秩；匹配滤波读出；等参数FFN扩展；分块三角系统求解与状态扫描。正文将窄投影拼为批量矩阵乘，状态保留片上VMEM，并把前缀和改写为MXU矩阵乘以减轻VPU负担。把门控敏感性与状态读出分析转为模型预算及矩阵单元友好的稳定内核。
digest.experimentsZh: 166M至1.34B的四个等参数规模，对比Transformer及GDN-2，统一头维128和循环模型chunk256。Transformer使用TPU Pallas Splash Attention，GDN-2为递归基线，另做读出增益与门控秩消融。摘要报告困惑度较GDN-2下降1.8–2.0%，32K训练较Transformer快2.7倍。正文内核分析称每token每头VPU计算减少24倍。节省门控参数在主实验中重新投入FFN，收益涉及多项共同变化。训练吞吐和极长流测试不能直接推断通用解码硬件加速。

papers.title: TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.

digest.summaryZh: TACT-KV利用三维视觉KV的空间相关性，以三轴DCT和频域位预算分配压缩缓存，并将逆变换融合到注意力tile。容量节省支持更大批量，实际吞吐增幅取决于变换开销和模型显存余量。
digest.motivationZh: 三维CT和MRI产生大量视觉token，KV随体积和批量增长造成显存压力。按单轴或特征统计压缩没有充分利用三轴空间关联。缓存压缩能扩大同显存并发，但需要限制解码重建的中间占用。直接关联KV量化和FlashAttention融合，可借鉴频域变换及低比特缓存执行设计。
digest.methodZh: 将视觉KV恢复三维布局，逐轴DCT后用反向注水分配频率位宽，再使用固定标量码本。三维KV布局；可分离三轴DCT；逐层频率位预算；固定码本；tile融合逆DCT与反量化。在单96GiB RTX PRO6000上评测，解码时把反量化和逆变换并入FlashAttention，避免物化完整重建缓存。把三轴频谱集中性转化为按频率分配精度的KV压缩，并提供融合解码路径。
digest.experimentsZh: 六个医学VLM、两个CT基准，另测四个通用视频VLM。部署评测为60轴向切片的Hulu-Med系列。质量比较包含KIVI、TurboQuant等，部署表以BF16缓存为参照，同时报告最大批量和匹配批量时间。正文最大批量扩展4–8倍，聚合吞吐为BF16的1.17–2.02倍。匹配批量下步延迟加速1.10–1.45倍，口径需分别读取。定理依赖高码率高斯及连续松弛假设，极低位宽下有有限率偏差。额外解码FLOPs和单GPU类别限制跨硬件外推。

papers.title: Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping
papers.abstract: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) enables energy-efficient AI inference by performing in-situ matrix multiplication. The growing demand for deploying larger models motivates chiplet integration to expand CIM capacity. However, simulation abstractions based on local operator costs and aggregate communication metrics obscure the impact of weight-mapping topology when CIM system scales up. We develop a phase analysis that quantifies how strongly mapping topology affects system performance across hardware configurations and how mapping optimization translates into latency gains. To evaluate and exploit this design space, we present Isobar, a simulation platform integrating CIM decompositions, heterogeneous execution, and resource modeling. Validated against silicon measurements and cycle-accurate simulation, Isobar provides reliable cost estimates that enable effective mapping search across model and hardware configurations. For Gemma-7B prefill, Isobar-guided mapping reduces communication time by 23.3% and end-to-end latency by 18.6% relative to the strongest baseline. Isobar's system-level modeling show that analog CIM retains energy-efficiency potential relative to GPU when scaled to thousands of dies, and identify topology-aware mapping as a key design dimension for efficient execution.

digest.summaryZh: Isobar为扩展模拟CIM建立拓扑感知评估，将共享链路争用、异构交接和KV访存纳入映射成本，再搜索物理布局。收益来自模拟平台的映射优化，适合借鉴多芯粒评测而非作为已流片加速器成果。
digest.motivationZh: 模拟CIM扩到大量芯粒后，相同通信总量可因物理布局不同产生不同拥塞。局部算子成本与总word-hops指标不能反映共享链路瓶颈及数字单元交接。忽略拓扑会选错映射，削弱对延迟和能耗扩展性的判断。与异构加速器互连及映射研究相关，CIM为次要背景，可重点参考资源争用和验证方法。
digest.methodZh: 沿执行图累计端口、链路、数字计算与KV服务成本，并以分层搜索优化算子分组及物理die布局。CIM分解与异构执行；路由资源负载模型；DP与模拟退火搜索；增量成本更新；硅测与BookSim对照。参考设置含2D mesh、XY路由、模拟CIM和独立数字注意力单元，建模materialized/tiled attention及工作区溢出。将物理资源服务时间和串并行执行纳入成本，区分相同传输总量下的争用。
digest.experimentsZh: OPT-6.7B、Gemma-7B和OPT-13B，batch1、512-token prefill，Gemma参考1232个CIM die。最强基线来自可行规则和500个随机布局的最低延迟候选，并与word-hops、max-hops选图对照。摘要Gemma-7B prefill通信时间降低23.3%，端到端骨干延迟降低18.6%。Simba芯粒距离延迟比验证相对误差5.1%。大规模CIM能效是模型估计，参考硬件带宽与阵列参数影响收益。验证部分来源于其他硅平台，未独立实现千die系统。

papers.abstract: The Controller Area Network (CAN) bus lacks built-in security mechanisms, making real-time intrusion detection necessary. However, resource and latency constraints limit vehicle-side intrusion detection systems (IDSs) to lightweight models, whose detection performance and generalization can degrade under non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data. Meanwhile, uploading original CAN messages to the cloud for more powerful model inference risks exposing sensitive vehicle information. We propose CANMentor, a large-small model collaboration framework in which a cloud-side large language model (LLM) teacher supervises vehicle-side lightweight IDS models for CAN bus intrusion detection. Each vehicle first performs local inference, and a privacy-aware generator then produces proxies from the original CAN messages for cloud-side teacher inference to protect data privacy. The vehicle uses the teacher prediction only when the response arrives within a prescribed latency bound and otherwise retains the local prediction; all returned teacher logits are converted into soft targets for periodic knowledge distillation. On non-IID partitions of the ROAD dataset and the HCRL Car-Hacking dataset, knowledge distillation yields maximum relative Macro F1 improvements of 25.01% and 20.79%, respectively. Teacher predictions also improve detection accuracy for CAN messages near the local decision boundary by 38.71-42.00 percentage points.

papers.title: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
papers.abstract: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-ν_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.

digest.summaryZh: LAQ在OPQ码本上增加远端排序违例的hinge目标，同时评估压缩记忆的近邻与全局结构。它保持索引字节和查询路径，通过离线码本训练改善全局保真，避免只看近邻召回而忽视主题漂移。
digest.motivationZh: Agent压缩向量后近邻可能保留，但合并、删除及跨主题比较依赖的全局结构会受损。仅优化重建或重打分难修复已存码的远端排序失真。全局结构关系到记忆组织和维护，需与局部检索共同评估。与Agent向量存储及量化算法相关，可略读同字节保真对比，硬件计算核心关联间接。
digest.methodZh: 从远端排序违例界推导hinge损失，固定OPQ旋转和编码大小，训练码本并监测重建约束。局部L与全局G指标；远近排序违例界；码本hinge训练；直通估计与监控集；百万条目扩展。查询仍使用OPQ的ADC路径，额外成本集中在离线训练。普通训练含两两排序，百万规模改用参考项抽样。把全局结构的理论界转成码本优化目标，补充传统重建与局部邻域目标。
digest.experimentsZh: 财报、会话及新闻记忆与六种编码器，留出集合比较，额外测试FinDER和百万MS MARCO条目。OPQ、重建目标及其他同大小量化器，比较有无far hinge及重打分策略。摘要报告LAQ在52个留出运行均提高G，且在12个Multi-Doc-2025运行的七种等大小量化器中G最高并保留证据召回。保真指标不是完整Agent任务成功率。离线训练存在排序与重编码成本，金融证据定位也含数据构建假设。

papers.title: MEMOIR: A Training-Free Memory Lifecycle for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents require memory systems that preserve useful information across sessions and retrieve it when needed. Existing systems treat these as separate problems: memories are written prospectively with static importance scores that are never revised after use. This creates two coupled failure modes: consolidation can silently destroy evidence that future queries require, while retrieval continues to favor stale memories. We propose MEMOIR (Memory Evidence via Merge-certified, Online Importance Revision), a training-free memory lifecycle that unifies judge-gated consolidation with retrospective attribution. Before compressing memory, screening gates test whether answer-relevant evidence is preserved. After each query, attribution estimates which retrieved memories supported the answer and updates their retrieval priority. A UCB-style exploration bonus additionally encourages retrieval of under-exposed memories, reducing the risk that frequently retrieved memories crowd out useful but less-seen evidence. On 1,905 deduplicated LoCoMo QA pairs, the full retrieval stack improves evidence recall@5 by 11.92 percentage points over bare cosine, with confidence-gated feedback adding 1.50 points overall without reference answers or reranker training; a deployment-unavailable oracle adds 1.84 points overall and 8.05 points on multi-hop. Judge-gated merge changes the recall of text-based evidence from 58.82% to 59.08%, reduces the active store by 1.42%, and incurs 0 observed losses in 100 independently audited merges, with a one-sided 95% upper loss-rate bound of 2.95%. Together, these results outline a practical deployment path: no additional LLM call on the online write path, with merge screening confined to periodic offline consolidation. The lifecycle reduces to one principle: attribute usefulness after use, and screen for preservation before compression.

papers.title: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations and conditional costs. These costs capture when a behavior is undesirable and steer the policy toward more desirable action regions. We experiment across 6 tasks and variations in object poses, scenes, and related tasks, and find that only a handful of corrective demonstrations can enable a VLA to overcome failures across a broad range of novel situations, without requiring new corrective data for each variation. Please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsierecover for videos.

papers.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
papers.abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.
